T16小秘境、蓝门与悬赏使用金织带、囤宝者和贪婪之戒组成金币链，配瑞秋戒与寅剑把.enUS: For T16 [[General/LootRunPortal]], blue portals and bounties, combine [[Items/Unique_Belt_010_x1]], [[Items/Unique_Gem_014_x1]] and [[Items/Unique_Ring_108_x1]] for the gold setup, with [[Items/Unique_Ring_104_x1]] and [[Items/Unique_Sword_1H_113_x1]] to minimize travel time and cooldowns. Once damage is sufficient, prioritize movement speed, cooldown reduction and pickup radius in gems and affixes. At high Paragon, consider [[Items/Unique_Ring_010_x1]] for survivability when approaching tier 110.

提丰多头蛇的核心武器/副手/套装乘区不可随意替换；缺少它时只算过渡配装。.enUS: The core weapon, off-hand and set multipliers of the Typhon Hydra build cannot be freely replaced; a setup missing this item is only transitional.

暗影飞刀后短时间内翻滚不消耗戒律。.enUS: For a short time after [[Powers/DemonHunter_Impale_name]], [[Powers/DemonHunter_Vault_name]] costs no Discipline.

亡者领域内高速吞噬，瞬间叠满后续尸枪乘区。.enUS: Use [[Powers/P6_Necro_Devour_name]] rapidly during [[Powers/P6_Necro_LandOfTheDead_name]] to instantly build the multiplier for subsequent Corpse Lance attacks.

少任意一件都会明显变脆；团结随从没有不死圣物时反而会断减伤。.enUS: Missing any piece significantly reduces survivability. With [[Items/Unique_Ring_010_x1]], a follower without an immortality relic can interrupt the damage reduction setup.

速刷时替换冲层武器.enUS: Replace the pushing weapon for speed farming.

每个受到诅咒的敌人都会提高你的伤害；怪群越密，脆弱光环的增伤越高。.enUS: Each cursed enemy increases your damage; denser groups make the damage boost from the [[Powers/P6_Necro_Frailty_name]] aura stronger.

魔女冷却最通用；冲层若需要暴击爆发可换盗贼，低巅峰缺治疗时可换圣殿骑士。.enUS: The cooldown benefit from the [[Pets/HirelingEnchantress]] is the most versatile. For pushing, use the [[Pets/HirelingScoundrel]] if you need critical-hit burst; at low Paragon, use the [[Pets/HirelingTemplar]] if you need [[Powers/Templar_Heal_110_name]].

结束后建立增伤.enUS: Build the damage boost after it ends.

Use [[Items/Unique_Sword_1H_113_x1]] or [[Items/P66_Unique_Axe_2H_011]] in slot 4 to reduce [[Powers/P6_Necro_SkeleBomb_name]] downtime, with [[Items/Unique_Gem_002_x1]] / [[Items/Unique_Gem_008_x1]] / [[Items/Unique_Gem_014_x1]] as gems.
